uber.com: 66. The gap: page titles.

Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 56 pages have no title.

The lesson for every team: Give every page a unique title of about 60 characters: the page first, the site second.

One automated analysis of public pages on 21 Oct 2026, requested through QA-lab URL Review. A starting point, not a verdict.
